title: Memorandum On The Korean Provisional Government In Shanghai

page_data.en:
MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
No. 3059
21. 1. 32.
January 20, 1932.

Memorandum on the Korean Provisional Government in Shanghai.

Following the independence movement in Korea in 1919,
many Korean revolutionists came to Shanghai and established
a temporary office in Avenue Joffre, French Concession.
Towards the end of March, 1919, a conference was held by
these revolutionists and it was decided to appoint the
following persons as officials of the Korean Provisional
Government:-

President:                                      Li To Min (李東寧)
Chief Secretary:                                Li Sho Ban (李承晚)
Chief of the Home Department:                   An Sho Ko (安昌浩)
Chief of the Foreign Department:                Kin Kei Shoku (金奎植)
Chief of the Legal Department:                  Li Shi Yei (李始榮)
Chief of the Finance Department:                Sai Kai Ryo(崔仕享)
Chief of the Military Department:               Li To Ko (李東輝)
Chief of the Communications Department:         Bun Sho Han(文昌範)

Owing to lack of funds this organization remained inactive
until 1925 when Korean residents in Europe and America promised
to contribute the necessary funds. The office was then
removed to its present address, No.4 Poo Ching Li (普慶里),
off Rue Brenier de Montmorand.

The activities of this organization during 1931 are
briefly as follows:-
January:    On January 3 Cho Wan Kyu, Chief of the Home
Department, convened a meeting of representatives of various
Korean organizations, which have connections with the
Government, at which, "The Policy to be Adopted in hastening
the Independence Movement", was discussed.
    On January 25 another meeting on the same subject was held
by representatives of Korean Inspectors of the Shanghai Tramway

登记处
第 3059 号
1932年1月21日。

1932年1月20日。

关于上海大韩民国临时政府的备忘录。

继1919年朝鲜独立运动之后，
许多朝鲜革命者来到上海，并在
法租界霞飞路设立了一个临时办事处。
1919年3月底，
这些革命者召开了一次会议，决定任命
下列人员为大韩民国临时政府官员：-

总统：                                      李东宁 (Li To Min)
国务总理：                                  李承晚 (Li Sho Ban)
内务总长：                                  安昌浩 (An Sho Ko)
外务总长：                                  金奎植 (Kin Kei Shoku)
法务总长：                                  李始荣 (Li Shi Yei)
财务总长：                                  崔仕享 (Sai Kai Ryo)
军务总长：                                  李东辉 (Li To Ko)
交通总长：                                  文昌范 (Bun Sho Han)

由于缺乏资金，该组织一直未开展活动，
直到1925年，旅居欧美各地的朝鲜居民承诺
提供必要资金。随后，办事处迁至
现址：白尔尼埃·德·蒙莫朗路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）旁的普庆里4号。

该组织在1931年的活动简述如下：-
一月：    1月3日，内务总长赵琬九召集了与
政府有联系的各朝鲜团体代表开会，
会上讨论了“加速独立运动所应采取的政策”。
    1月25日，上海电车公司和
通用汽车公司（General Omnibus Company）的朝鲜稽查员代表
就同一主题再次举行会议，

page_data.en:
-2-

Company and the General Omnibus Company when it was decided
to make contributions to the Government.

A pamphlet in Chinese entitled "The Problems of Korean
Residents in the Three Eastern Provinces" was sent to
certain Chinese Government officials requesting them to use
their influence with the Government to moderate its oppressive
policy toward Koreans in those provinces.

February: Cho So Ko, Chief of the Foreign Department,
proceeded to Nanking and submitted an appeal to the Nanking
Government for the protection of Korean nationals in Manchuria.

March: A statement was issued over the joint signatures
of the officials of the Provisional Government on the occasion
of the anniversary of the declaration of Korean Independence.

May: On the occasion of the Chinese National
Conference held in Nanking, they despatched a congratulatory
telegram to representatives attending the meeting requesting
at the same time their support in the settlement of the
Korean problems in the Three Eastern Provinces.

A manifesto describing the policy of the Provisional
Government and the demands of the Independence Party was
distributed to representatives of various provinces who
attended the conference.

July: Following the Van Pao San Incident and the
anti-Chinese movement in Korea, Committee members of the
Home Department held meetings almost daily to devise ways
and means to adopt counter measures.

On July 8 a statement was issued in the name of Cho
So Ko, Chief of the Foreign Department, declaring that the
attack on the Chinese in Korea by Koreans was deliberately
planned by the Japanese Imperialists, with the knowledge of
the Nanking Government.

On July 9 An Sho Ko, and several other members of the
Home Department organized the Amalgamated Association of
various Korean Organizations in order to cope with the
page_data.zh:
-2-

决定向政府捐款。

一份题为《东三省朝鲜居民问题》的中文
小册子被发送给某些中国政府官员，请求他们
利用其对政府的影响力，缓和政府在这些省份
对朝鲜人的压迫政策。

二月：外务总长赵素昂前往南京，
向南京政府提交请愿书，要求保护
满洲地区的朝鲜国民。

三月：在大韩民国独立宣言周年纪念日之际，
以临时政府官员联名名义发表了一份声明。

五月：在南京举行中国国民会议期间，
他们向出席会议的代表发出贺电，
同时请求他们在解决东三省朝鲜人问题
上给予支持。

一份阐述临时政府政策及独立党诉求的
宣言，被分发给参加会议的各省代表。

七月：继万宝山事件及朝鲜反华运动之后，
内务部委员几乎每日开会， devising 对策及方法。

7月8日，以外务总长赵素昂的名义发表声明，
宣称朝鲜人对中国人的袭击是日本帝国主义者
蓄意策划的，且南京政府对此知情。

7月9日，安昌浩及内务部其他几名成员
组织了各朝鲜团体联合会，以应对

page_data.en:
-3-
situation. They contributed articles to Chinese newspapers under the heading of "The Slanderous Policy of the Japanese Imperialists".
On July 10 An Sho Yo, Chief of the Foreign Department, issued a manifesto in Chinese on the attack of Chinese in Korea stating that this incident was created by Koreans who were instigated by Japanese Imperialists and that Korean members of the Provisional Government earnestly desired the Chinese nationals to secure revenge, and that they were prepared to join with them.
On the occasion of the memorial service for the Chinese victims of the Korean incident, held under the auspices of the Anti-Japanese Association on July 23 in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, Kan Tai Chu (韓泰宙) and Kim Gen Kei (金元慶) were appointed as representatives of the Provisional Government to attend the service. They distributed pamphlets entitled "Manifesto on the Attack on Chinese in Korea" and "An Address to the Chinese Nationals".
September: On September 20 members of the Home Department held a meeting in order to consider counter-propaganda measures. They contributed several articles to Chinese newspapers denouncing Japanese activities in South Manchuria.
On September 22 Cho So Ko, Chief of the Foreign Department, despatched a letter to the Nanking Government requesting them to resist the occupation of Manchuria by Japan, thereby bringing glory to China and Korea.
October: On October 10 the establishment of the Headquarters of the Korean Volunteer Corps was announced as a premise for the organization of the Chinese and Korean Allied Forces to fight against Japan.
Extracts from this announcement are as follows:-
"In establishing the Korean Volunteer Corps, members are recruited from dare-to-die patriotic persons. - For the sake of our country and nationals, let us sacrifice ourselves and
page_data.zh:
-3-
局势。他们以“日本帝国主义的诽谤政策”为标题，
向中文报纸投稿。
7月10日，外务总长安孝玉（音译）(An Sho Yo) 发布中文宣言，
谈及在朝鲜发生的袭击中国人事件，称此事件是由
受日本帝国主义者煽动的朝鲜人所制造，并声称
临时政府的朝鲜成员恳切希望中国国民进行报复，
且准备与中国国民联手行动。
7月23日，在反日协会主持下于上海总商会
举行的朝鲜事件中国遇难者追悼会上，
韩泰宙 (Kan Tai Chu) 和金元庆 (Kim Gen Kei) 被任命为
临时政府代表出席追悼会。他们分发了题为
《关于在朝鲜袭击中国人的宣言》和
《告中国同胞书》的小册子。
九月：9月20日，内务部成员举行会议，
商讨反宣传措施。他们向中文报纸投递了数篇文章，
谴责日本在南满的活动。
9月22日，外务总长赵素昂致信南京政府，
请求其抵抗日本对满洲的占领，从而为中朝两国
带来荣耀。
十月：10月10日，宣布成立韩国义勇队总部，
作为组建中韩联军抗日的前提。
该公告摘录如下：-
“在建立韩国义勇队时，队员从敢死爱国人士中招募。
- 为了我们的国家和国民，让我们牺牲自己和

page_data.en:
-4-
our homes for the extermination of our common enemy, the
Japanese Imperialists. Compatriots who have a grudge against
our enemy should rise and come under the flag of the Volunteer
Corps to revenge our fathers and brothers".
On October 20 Cho Sc Yo, Chief of the Foreign Department,
despatched a telegram to Mr. Briand through Mr. Drummond,
Secretary of the League of Nations, Geneva, stating that,
"with due respect to the League, 23,000,000 Koreans earnestly
desire that drastic measures be adopted to suppress the
occupation of Manchuria by the barbarous Japanese, We are
definitely opposed to Japanese protection of Koreans both in
Korea and Manchuria. We have no alternative but to adopt
drastic military action against the Japanese in order to
emancipate our homeland from the grip of our oppressors and
to declare Korea's Independence".
On October 22 An Sho Ko, President of the Shanghai
Korean Residents' Association and concurrently the State
Secretary of the Korean Provisional Government, entertained
some twenty reporters of various Chinese newspapers to a dinner
in the Shing Ling Restaurant. He delivered a speech to the
effect that co-operation of Chinese and Koreans is necessary
to overthrow Japanese Imperialism, and distributed to them
leaflet entitled "The True Opinion of Koreans".
On October 25 An Sho Ko issued a circular addressed to the
Chinese people denouncing the action of the Japanese Government
in connection with the occupation of South Manchuria.
December: At the mass meeting held at the Public Recreation
Ground on December 18 by Chinese students, ten members of the
Provisional Government were present and they participated in the
demonstration held at the conclusion of the meeting.
On December 17 Li Ho Sho (李奉昌), member of the
Provisional Government, proceeded to Japan by the s.s. "Hikawa
Maru" with the object of assassinating the Japanese Emperor.
page_data.zh:
-4-
家园，以消灭我们共同的敌人——
日本帝国主义者。对敌人怀有仇恨的同胞们
应奋起加入义勇队的旗帜下，为我们的父兄报仇”。
10月20日，外务总长赵素昂 (Cho Sc Yo) 通过
日内瓦国际联盟秘书长德拉蒙德先生，
向布里安先生发送电报，称，“出于对国联的尊重，
两千三百万朝鲜人恳切希望采取严厉措施，
镇压野蛮日本对满洲的占领。我们坚决反对
日本在朝鲜和满洲对朝鲜人的‘保护’。为了将
祖国从压迫者的魔掌中解放出来并宣布朝鲜独立，
我们别无选择，只能对日本人采取严厉的军事行动”。
10月22日，上海朝鲜人居留民团团长兼
大韩民国临时政府国务总理安昌浩，
在新林酒家宴请了约二十位各中文报纸记者。
他发表演讲，大意是中朝合作对于推翻
日本帝国主义是必要的，并向他们分发了题为
《朝鲜人的真实意见》的传单。
10月25日，安昌浩发布致中国人民的通函，
谴责日本政府在南满占领问题上的行动。
十二月：12月18日，中国学生在公共游乐场
举行群众大会，临时政府十名成员出席，
并参加了会议结束后的示威游行。
12月17日，临时政府成员李奉昌 (Li Ho Sho)
乘坐“日枝丸”轮 (s.s. "Hikawa Maru") 前往日本，
目的是刺杀日本天皇。

page_data.en:
-5-

For this purpose he obtained two bombs and the sum of Yen 300
from a certain source in Shanghai. While in Tokyo he
received, through the Yokohama Specie Bank the sum of Yen 100
which was sent by Kim Kyu alias Kim Ki alias Haku Tei Zen
alias Haku Bon, who is the Chief of the Finance Department
of the Korean Provisional Government.

Li Yo Sho was arrested in Tokyo on January 8, 1932,
in connection with the attempted assassination of the
Japanese Emperor by throwing a bomb.

The present officials of the Korean Provisional
Government are as follows:-

President:                                Li To Min    (李東寧)
Chief of the Home Department:             Cho Yen Kyu  (趙琬九)
Chief of the Foreign Department:          Cho So Ho    (趙素昂)
Chief of the Military Department:         Kin Tetsu    (金 澈)
Chief of the Legal Department:            Li To Min    (李東寧)
Chief of the Finance Department:          Kim Kyu      (金 九).
page_data.zh:
-5-

为此，他从上海某处获得两枚炸弹和300日元。
在东京期间，他通过横滨正金银行收到
由金九 (Kim Kyu)（又名金基 (Kim Ki)，又名白铁全 (Haku Tei Zen)，
又名白盆 (Haku Bon)，系大韩民国临时政府财务总长）
寄来的100日元。

李尧秀 (Li Yo Sho) 于1932年1月8日在东京被捕，
涉嫌投掷炸弹企图刺杀日本天皇。

大韩民国临时政府现任官员如下：-

总统：                                李东宁 (Li To Min)
内务总长：                             赵琬九 (Cho Yen Kyu)
外务总长：                             赵素昂 (Cho So Ho)
军务总长：                             金澈 (Kin Tetsu)
法务总长：                             李东宁 (Li To Min)
财务总长：                             金九 (Kim Kyu)。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
C.I.D. 12 C. Station,
D. D. 3059.
Date January 7 / 1 '32.

Subject (in full) Japanese authorities raid the Korean Provisional Government.

Made by D. S. Memoto. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to D.C. Kim's report of January 6 on the
subject of a raid made by the Japanese Consular Police in the
French Concession, I beg to report that on the morning of January
5 the Japanese Consular Police with the assistance of the French
Police raided the headquarters of the Korean Provisional Govern-
ment, No. 4 Poo Ching Li (普慶里), Rue Brenier de Montmorand,
and No. 14 Route Say Joong, the residence of Cho So Ho (趙素昂),
official of that Government. No arrests were made, but two pairs
of handcuffs, a Korean flag, two banners and a quantity of
documents including the archives of this organisation together
with certain secret communications, were seized.

A Chinese lodging house at No. 8 Avenue Dubail was also
raided in an attempt to arrest a Korean named Li Sei Yei (李世榮)
who is wanted on a warrant issued by the Korean Court on a charge
of embezzlement. This individual, it is reported, left Shanghai
for Tientsin some time ago.

[Signature]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Commissioner of Police,
Sir,
[Signature] information.
W. Grierson
7: 1: '32.

Recd
8 JAN. 1932

报告

档案号。
刑事侦缉处 12 C 站，
D. D. 3059。
日期 1932年1月7日 / 1 '32。

主题（全称） 日本当局搜查大韩民国临时政府。

制作人 D. S. Memoto。转发人 [签名]

鉴于 D.C. Kim 于1月6日提交的关于
日本领事警察在法租界进行搜查的报告，
谨此报告，1月5日上午，日本领事警察
在法国警察的协助下，搜查了位于
白尔尼埃·德·蒙莫朗路普庆里4号的大韩民国临时政府总部，
以及该政府官员赵素昂 (Cho So Ho) 的住所赛忠路14号。
无人被捕，但查获手铐两副、朝鲜国旗一面、
横幅两条以及大量文件，包括该组织的档案
及某些秘密通讯。

杜拜路8号的一家华人旅馆也遭到搜查，
试图逮捕一名名为李世荣 (Li Sei Yei) 的朝鲜人，
此人因被朝鲜法院以挪用公款罪签发通缉令而遭通缉。
据报道，此人已于前一段时间离开上海前往天津。

[签名]
D. S.

特别分部主管警官。

警务处处长，
先生，
[签名] 供阅。
W. Grierson
1932年1月7日。

收讫
1932年1月8日
[签名] 归档 [签名]
1932年1月11日。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch No. 5
File No. POLICE REGISTRY
D. D. 3059
Station,
6. I. 32.
Date January 6. 1932

Subject (in full) Japanese authorities raid the Korean Provisional Government.

Made by D.S. Kim Forwarded by [Signature] G.S.I.

It is reported that at 10.30 a.m. yesterday
Japanese Consular officials with the assistance of the French
Police raided the Korean Provisional Government at No. 4
Puh Ching Li, Rue Brenier de Montmorand, French Concession
and seized two pairs of hand cuffs and a quantity of Korean documents.
No arrests were made because all the members of the Korean
Provisional Government had made good their escape before the
arrival of the party as they had been informed of the raid
beforehand.

H. C. Kim
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

~2. Passed to you on instructions of O.C. S.B.
6/1/32

档案号 警务处登记处

站，
1932年1月6日。
日期 1932年1月6日

主题（全称） 日本当局搜查大韩民国临时政府。

制作人 D.S. Kim 转发人 [签名] G.S.I.

据报道，昨日上午10时30分，
日本领事官员在法国警察的协助下，
搜查了位于法租界白尔尼埃·德·蒙莫朗路
普庆里4号的大韩民国临时政府，
并查获手铐两副及大量朝鲜文件。
由于大韩民国临时政府所有成员事先已获知
搜查消息，在行动组到达之前均已逃脱，
故无人被捕。

H. C. Kim
D. S.

特别分部主管警官。
